input: Schedule my annual blood pressure check

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing which doctor or clinic to contact (GP, cardiologist, pharmacy, etc.) determines who needs to be reached and how to book.
Whether the user has already chosen a preferred date or timeframe affects how urgently the task needs to be actioned and what slots to look for.
Knowing how they plan to book — phone, online portal, app, walk-in — determines the immediate next step.
Availability constraints such as days of the week or times they cannot attend narrows down suitable appointment slots.
Whether this is a standalone BP check or part of a broader annual physical changes the type of appointment to book and its likely duration.
Understanding what 'done' looks like — e.g., confirmation received, reminder set, results reviewed — defines when the task is truly complete.
Whether the user prefers an in-person visit, telehealth, or a self-service option like a pharmacy kiosk shapes which provider or format to pursue.

gold.taskTitle: Schedule annual blood pressure check appointment
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to book their yearly blood pressure check with a relevant healthcare provider.

questions.title: Which doctor or clinic will you book this with?

questions.title: Do you have a target date or month in mind?

questions.title: How do you plan to book the appointment?

questions.title: Are there days or times you are not available?
questions.description: Capture scheduling constraints such as work hours or weekly commitments to filter suitable appointment slots.

questions.title: Is this a standalone BP check or part of a full physical?
questions.description: Clarify the scope of the appointment to ensure the right type and length of visit is requested.

questions.title: What will make this task feel fully complete to you?
questions.description: Define the end state — confirmation received, calendar reminder set, results reviewed — so the task has a clear finish line.

questions.title: Do you prefer in-person, telehealth, or a pharmacy visit?
questions.description: Understand the preferred format for the appointment to match the right provider type and setting.
